svg.text: M6-L2 optional FoxPro2 cable: J8 contact numbers are PCB numbers
VOLTAGE N/A for BOTH2S and4S. No battery or power rail is exported.
Cross-reference: DF1FO Zeitsteuerung2G pp9/15 plug plus physical jack sketch;
Reichelt EBS35 / Ledino KB3SPRS contact construction. Sleeve1; ring3; tip2.
Switched terminals4/5 unused. Other jacks: identify T/R/S by inserted-plug continuity.
Unpowered test required: S-S, R-R, T-T only; no cross shorts. Actual cable test NOT_RUN.
J8 is PH2mm and is not the XH battery connector. FoxPro has its own battery.
